title: Turn an iOS Screen Into the Unit of Agent Work
summary: Landseer Enga describes a design-QA loop where a designer selects the real app screen, states the correction, and a cloud agent edits, rebuilds on macOS, navigates a cloud device, and returns before-and-after evidence plus a tappable preview in the pull request. An iOS team can pilot the pattern on low-risk visual changes while preserving human review and merge control.
takeaway: Bind visual requests to a specific screen and device size, then require the agent to return a built preview, exercised path, and before-and-after screenshots before a human reviews the pull request.
